english: In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
All Glory be to Allah,
all praise be to Allah,
there is no god save Allah,
Allah is the Greatest,

arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al`aliyyi al`azimi
english: there is neither power nor might save with Allah, the Most High, the All-magnificent.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ آنَاءَ ٱللَّيْلِ وَاطْرَافَ ٱلنَّهَارِ
transliteration: subhana allahi ana'a allayli wa atrafa alnnahari
english: Glory be to Allah in hours of the night and at the two ends of the day.
Glory be to Allah in the morning and the evening hours.
Glory be to Allah in the early hours of night and morning.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ
transliteration: subhana allahi hina tumsuna wa hina tusbihuna
english: Glory be to Allah when you enter the night and when you enter the morning.

transliteration: wa lahu alhamdu fi alssamawati wal-ardi
english: Unto Him be praise in the heavens, the earth,
at the sun's decline, and in the noonday.
He brings forth the living from the dead,
brings forth the dead from the living,
revives the earth after its death,
and even so will you be brought forth.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
english: Glorified be Your Lord, the Lord of Majesty, from that which they attribute (to Him).
Peace be upon the Messengers.
All praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.
Glory be to the Lord of Kingdom and Realm.
Glory be to the Lord of Majesty and Magnificence.
Glory be to the Lord of Greatness and Magnitude;
the True Sovereign, the Guardian, and the Holy.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَلِكِ ٱلْحَيِّ ٱلَّذِي لاَ يَمُوتُ
transliteration: subhana allahi almaliki alhayyi alladhi la yamutu
english: Glory be to Allah, the Sovereign, the Ever-living Who never dies.
Glory be to Allah, the Ever-living, the Holy.
Glory be to the Self-Existent, the Eternal.
Glory be to the Eternal, the Self-Existent.
Glory be to my Lord, the Most Great.
Glory be to my Lord, the Most High.
Glory be to the Ever-living, the Self-Existent.
Glory be to the Exalted, the Most High.
Glory be to Him, and Exalted be Him.
Glorified (is He), Holy (is He),
Our Lord, and the Lord of the angels and the Spirit.
Glory be to the Eternal Who never forgets.
Glory be to the All-knowing Who does not need teaching.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ خَالِقِ مَا يُرَىٰ وَمَا لاَ يُرَىٰ
transliteration: subhana khaliqi ma yura wa ma la yura
english: Glory be to the Creator of all seen and unseen beings.
Glory be to Him Who comprehends all visions,
but visions cannot comprehend Him,
and He is the Knower of subtleties, the Aware.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اصْبَحْتُ مِنْكَ فِي نِعْمَةٍ وَخَيْرٍ
transliteration: allahumma inni asbahtu minka fi ni`matin wa khayrin
english: O Allah, I begin my day covered with grace and favor from You
as well as blessing and good health.
So, (please) bless Muhammad and his Household,
make perfect Your grace and favor for me
as well as Your blessings and good health,
through redemption from Hellfire,
grant me thanksgiving to You, enjoyment of wellbeing from You,

transliteration: wa fadlaka wa karamataka abadan ma abqaytani
english: Your grace, and Your honor permanently so long as You decide to keep me alive.
O Allah, only by Your Light have I been guided,
only by Your grace have I been opulent,
and only by Your grace have I lived in eves and morns.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اشْهِدُكَ وَكَفَىٰ بِكَ شَهِيداً
transliteration: allahumma inni ush-hiduka wa kafa bika shahidan
english: O Allah, I ask You to witness for me, and You are surely sufficient as a witness,

transliteration: wa ush-hidu mala'ikataka wa anbiya'aka wa rusulaka
english: and I also choose as witnesses Your angels, Prophets, Messengers,

transliteration: wa hamalata `arshika wa sukkana samawatika wa ardika
english: the bearers of Your Throne, the inhabitants of Your heavens and earth,
and all Your creatures,

arabic: بِانَّكَ انْتَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ
transliteration: bi'annaka anta allahu la ilaha illa anta
english: that You are Allah, there is no god save You,
One and Only Lord, having no partner,

arabic: وَانَّ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
transliteration: wa anna muhammadan salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi `abduka wa rasuluka
english: and that Muhammad, peace be upon him and his Household, is Your servant and Messenger,

arabic: وَانَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْ ءٍ قَدِيرٌ
english: and that You have power over all things;

transliteration: tuhyi wa tumitu wa tumitu wa tuhyi
english: You grant life and cause to die and You cause to die and grant life;
and I witness that Paradise is true,
Hellfire is true,
Resurrection is true,
the Hour is coming, there is no doubt about it,

arabic: وَانَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْعَثُ مَنْ فِي ٱلْقُبُورِ
transliteration: wa anna allaha yab`athu man fi alquburi
english: and Allah shall raise up those who are in graves.

arabic: وَاشْهَدُ انَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ ابِي طَالِبٍ امِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَقّاً حَقّاً
transliteration: wa ash-hadu anna `aliyya bna abi talibin amiru almu'minina haqqan haqqan
english: I also witness that `Ali the son of Abu-Talib is truly the commander of the faithful, indeed,

arabic: وَانَّ ٱلائِمَّةَ مِنْ وُلْدِهِ هُمُ ٱلائِمَّةُ ٱلْهُدَاةُ ٱلْمَهْدِيُّونَ
transliteration: wa anna al-a'immata min wuldihi hum al-a'immatu alhudatu almahdiyyuna
english: the Imams from his offspring are the guides, leaders, and well-guided,
neither straying off nor misleading,
and they are Your chosen representatives,
Your triumphant party,

transliteration: wa sifwatuka wa khiyaratuka min khalqika
english: Your choice, the most favorable of all Your creatures,
the superior ones whom You have selected for Your religion,
decided on from among Your beings,
chosen from among Your servants,
and made Claims against all beings.

arabic: صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱلسَّلاَمُ وَرَحْمَةُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
transliteration: salawatuka `alayhim wa alssalamu wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
english: May Your consent, peace, mercy, and blessings be upon them.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ٱكْتُبْ لِي هٰذِهِ ٱلشَّهَادَةَ عِنْدَكَ
english: O Allah, (please do) certify this witness for me with You

arabic: حَتَّىٰ تُلَقِّنَنِيهَا يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ وَانْتَ عَنِّي رَاضٍ
transliteration: hatta tulaqqinaniha yawma alqiyamati wa anta `anni radin
english: so that You shall give it back to me on the Resurrection Day while You are pleased with me.
Verily, You have power over all that which You will.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ حَمْداً يَصْعَدُ اوَّلُهُ وَلاَ يَنْفَدُ آخِرُهُ
transliteration: allahumma laka alhamdu hamdan yas`adu awwaluhu wa la yanfadu akhiruhu
english: O Allah, to You be praise the first of which ascends while its end is infinite.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ حَمْداً تَضَعُ لَكَ ٱلسَّمَاءُ كَنَفَيْهَا
transliteration: allahumma laka alhamdu hamdan tada`u laka alssama'u kanafayha
english: O Allah, to You be praise due to which the heavens humbles itself to You

transliteration: wa tusabbihu laka al-ardu wa man `alayha
english: and the earth as well as all those on it glorify You.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ حَمْداً سَرْمَداً ابَداً
transliteration: allahumma laka alhamdu hamdan sarmadan abadan
english: O Allah, to You be praise—eternal, endless,

transliteration: la inqita`a lahu wa la nafada
english: having neither cessation nor exhaustion,

transliteration: wa laka yanbaghi wa ilayka yantahi
english: fitting You, and being dedicated to You,
about me, on (Your favors to) me, with me,

transliteration: wa ma`i wa qabli wa ba`di
english: along with me, before me, after me,

transliteration: wa amami wa fawqi wa tahti
english: in front of me, over me, beneath me,

arabic: وَإِذَا مِتُّ وَبَقِيتُ فَرْداً وَحِيداً ثُمَّ فَنِيتُ
transliteration: wa idha mittu wa baqitu fardan wahidan thumma fanitu
english: when I die, remain totally alone, and will be then terminated.

transliteration: wa laka alhamdu idha nushirtu wa bu`ithtu
english: To You be all praise when I shall be resurrected and raised up (from grave).

transliteration: ya mawlaya allahumma wa laka alhamdu
english: O my Lord, O Allah, to You be all praise

transliteration: wa laka alshshukru bijami`i mahamidika kulliha
english: and all thanks in all forms of praising You
for all Your favors

arabic: حَتَّىٰ يَنْتَهِيَ ٱلْحَمْدُ إِلَىٰ مَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَتَرْضَىٰ
transliteration: hatta yantahiya alhamdu ila ma tuhibbu rabbana wa tarda
english: until (this) praise achieves the pleasure and satisfaction of You, O our Lord.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ اكْلَةٍ وَشَرْبَةٍ
transliteration: allahumma laka alhamdu `ala kulli aklatin wa sharbatin
english: O Allah, to You be all praise for each and every food, drink,
power, grip,

transliteration: wa bastatin wa fi kulli mawdi`i sha`ratin
english: extension, and for each place of a single hair.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ حَمْداً خَالِداً مَعَ خُلُودِكَ
transliteration: allahumma laka alhamdu hamdan khalidan ma`a khuludika
english: O Allah, to You be all praise that is as eternal as You are.

arabic: وَلَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ حَمْداً لاَ مُنْتَهَىٰ لَهُ دُونَ عِلْمِكَ
transliteration: wa laka alhamdu hamdan la muntaha lahu duna `ilmika
english: To You be all praise that never ends save Your knowledge (about it).

arabic: وَلَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ حَمْداً لاَ امَدَ لَهُ دُونَ مَشِيَّتِكَ
transliteration: wa laka alhamdu hamdan la amada lahu duna mashi'atika
english: To You be all praise that has no limit save when You will.

arabic: وَلَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ حَمْداً لاَ اجْرَ لِقَائِلِهِ إِلاَّ رِضَاكَ
transliteration: wa laka alhamdu hamdan la ajra liqa'ilihi illa ridaka
english: To You be all praise the one and only reward of its sayer is nothing save Your pleasure.

arabic: وَلَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ عَلَىٰ حِلْمِكَ بَعْدَ عِلْمِكَ
english: To You be all praise for You act forbearingly though You know.

arabic: وَلَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ عَلَىٰ عَفْوِكَ بَعْدَ قُدْرَتِكَ
english: To You be all praise for You pardon though You have power (not to do).
To You be all praise and You are the source of praise.
To You be all praise and You are the inheritor of praise.
To You be all praise and You are the fashioner of praise.
To You be all praise and You are the utmost of praise.
To You be all praise and You are the author of praise.
To You be all praise and You are the object of praise.
To You be all praise and You are the lord of praise.
To You be all praise and You are the ultimate objective of praise.

arabic: وَلَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ صَادِقَ ٱلْوَعْدِ وَفِيَّ ٱلْعَهْدِ
transliteration: wa laka alhamdu sadiqa alwa`di wafiyya al`ahdi
english: To You be all praise and You are truthful in promise, fulfiller of pledge,
mighty in power, and subsistingly glorious.

arabic: وَلَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ رَفِيعَ ٱلدَّرَجَاتِ مُجِيبَ ٱلدَّعَوَاتِ
transliteration: wa laka alhamdu rafi`a alddarajati mujiba aldda`awati
english: To You be all praise and You are the highest in ranks, the responsive to prayers,

arabic: مُنَزِّلَ ٱلآيَاتِ مِنْ فَوْقِ سَبْعِ سَمَاوَاتٍ
transliteration: munazzila al-ayati min fawqi sab`i samawatin
english: the descender of sings (or Verses) from above seven skies,
the grantor of outstanding blessings,
the bringer forth of light from utter darkness,

arabic: وَمُخْرِجَ مَنْ فِي ٱلظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَىٰ ٱلنُّورِ
transliteration: wa mukhrija man fi alzzulumati ila alnnuri
english: the bringer forth of those who are in darkness to light,
the changer of evil deeds into good deeds,
and the maker of good deeds raise to high ranks.

arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ غَافِرَ ٱلذَّنْبِ وَقَابِلَ ٱلتَّوْبِ
transliteration: allahumma laka alhamdu ghafira aldhdhanbi wa qabila alttawbi
english: O Allah, to You be all praise and You are the Forgiver of the faults, the Acceptor of repentance,
severe to punish, and Lord of bounty.

arabic: لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
transliteration: la ilaha illa anta ilayka almasiru
english: There is no god save You; to You shall be the return.

arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِي ٱللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
transliteration: allahumma laka alhamdu fi allayli idha yaghsha
english: O Allah, to You be all praise in the night when it draws a veil.

arabic: وَلَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
transliteration: wa laka alhamdu fi alnnahari idha tajalla
english: To You be all praise in the day when it shines in brightness.

transliteration: wa laka alhamdu fi al-akhirati wal-ula
english: To You be all praise in the Hereafter and the former life.

arabic: وَلَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ كُلِّ نَجْمٍ وَمَلَكٍ فِي ٱلسَّمَاءِ
transliteration: wa laka alhamdu `adada kulli najmin wa malakin fi alssama'i
english: To You be all praise as many as the numbers of all stars and angels in the heavens.

arabic: وَلَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ وَٱلْحَصَىٰ وَٱلنَّوَىٰ
transliteration: wa laka alhamdu `adada alththara walhasa walnnawa
english: To You be all praise as much as dust and as many as pebbles and seeds.

arabic: وَلَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ مَا فِي جَوِّ ٱلسَّمَاءِ
transliteration: wa laka alhamdu `adada ma fi jawwi alssama'i
english: To You be all praise as many as all that which is in the air.

arabic: وَلَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ مَا فِي جَوْفِ ٱلارْضِ
transliteration: wa laka alhamdu `adada ma fi jawfi al-ardi
english: To You be all praise as many as all that which is in the interior of the earth.

arabic: وَلَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ اوْزَانِ مِيَاهِ ٱلْبِحَارِ
transliteration: wa laka alhamdu `adada awzani miyahi albihari
english: To You be all praise as much as the weight of sea water.
To You be all praise as many as leaves of trees.

arabic: وَلَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ مَا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِ ٱلارْضِ
transliteration: wa laka alhamdu `adada ma `ala wajhi al-ardi
english: To You be all praise as many as all that which exists on the earth surface.

arabic: وَلَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ مَا احْصَىٰ كِتَابُكَ
transliteration: wa laka alhamdu `adada ma ahsa kitabuka
english: To You be all praise as much as that which has been counted by Your Book.

arabic: وَلَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ مَا احَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ
transliteration: wa laka alhamdu `adada ma ahata bihi `ilmuka
english: To You be all praise as much as all that which is comprehended by Your Knowledge.
To You be all praise as many as the numbers of men, jinn,
pests, birds, animals, and beasts—
praise that is abundant, pleasant,

arabic: مُبَارَكاً فِيهِ كَمَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَتَرْضَىٰ
transliteration: mubarakan fihi kama tuhibbu rabbana wa tarda
english: and as blessed as You, our Lord, please and gratify

arabic: وَكَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِكَرَمِ وَجْهِكَ وَعِزِّ جَلاَلِكَ
transliteration: wa kama yanbaghi likarami wajhika wa `izzi jalalika
english: so much so that it befits the majesty of Your Face and the dignity of Your splendor.
Then, repeat the following statements ten times each:

arabic: لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
transliteration: la ilaha illa allahu wahdahu la sharika lahu lahu almulku wa lahu alhamdu wa huwa allatifu alkhabiru
english: There is no god save Allah; One and Only and having no partner. To Him is the Kingdom and to Him is (all) praise. He is the Knower of subtleties, the Aware.

arabic: لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَيُمِيتُ وَيُحْيِي وَهُوَحَيٌّ لاَ يَمُوتُ بِيَدِهِ ٱلْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliteration: la ilaha illa allahu wahdahu la sharika lahu lahu almulku wa lahu alhamdu yuhyi wa yumitu wa yumitu wa yuhyi wa huwa hayyun la yamutu biyadihi alkhayru wa huwa `ala kulli shay'in qadirun
english: There is no god save Allah; One and Only and having no partner. To Him is the Kingdom and to Him is (all) praise. He gives life and causes to die and causes to die and gives life, while He is ever-living and never dies. In His Hand is the entire goodness and He has power over all things.

arabic: اسْتَغْفِرُ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِي لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ ٱلْحَيُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ وَاتُوبُ إِلَيْه
transliteration: astaghfiru allaha alladhi la ilaha illa huwa alhayyu alqayyumu wa atubu ilayhi
english: I pray the forgiveness of Allah; there is no god save Him, the Ever-living, the Self-subsistent, and I repent to Him.
O Allah, O Allah!
O All-beneficent, O All-beneficent!
O All-merciful, O All-merciful!
O Fashioner of the heavens and the earth!
O Lord of Majesty and Dignity!
O All-compassionate! O Grantor (of graces)!
O Ever-living! O Self-Subsistent!

arabic: يَا حَيُّ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ
transliteration: ya hayyu la ilaha illa anta
english: O Ever-living! There is no god save You!

arabic: يَا ٱللَّهُ يَا لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ
transliteration: ya allahu ya la ilaha illa anta
english: O Allah! O He save Whom there is no god!
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ٱفْعَلْ بِي مَا انْتَ اهْلُهُ
transliteration: allahumma if`al bi ma anta ahluhu
english: O Allah, do to me that which You are worthy to do.
(please do) Respond, respond.
Say: He, Allah, is One.
You should then say the following:

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ٱصْنَعْ بِي مَا انْتَ اهْلُهُ
transliteration: allahumma isna` bi ma anta ahluhu
english: O Allah, do with me that which You are worthy to do

arabic: وَلاَ تَصْنَعْ بِي مَا انَا اهْلُهُ
transliteration: wa la tasna` bi ma ana ahluhu
english: but do not do to me that which I deserve,

transliteration: fa'innaka ahlu alttaqwa wa ahlu almaghfirati
english: for You are worthy to be feared and worthy to forgive,
while I am the one of sins and faults.
So, have mercy upon me, O my Lord,
and You are the most merciful of all those who show mercy.
Then repeat the following ten times:

arabic: لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ
transliteration: la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi
english: There is neither power nor might save with Allah.

arabic: تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحَيِّ ٱلَّذِي لاَ يَمُوتُ
english: I trust in the Ever-living (Lord) Who never dies.

arabic: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَداً
transliteration: walhamdu lillahi alladhi lm yattakhidh waladan
english: All praise be to Allah, Who begets no son,

arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيكٌ فِي ٱلْمُلْكِ
transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu sharikun fi almulki
english: and has no partner in His dominion

arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلِيٌّ مِنَ ٱلذُّلِّ
transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu waliyyun mina aldhdhulli
english: nor needs He any to protect Him from humiliation:
yea, magnify Him for His greatness and glory!
